event.past_the_point.wren.text: Just looking, that's all. From the point, the sea seems to start somewhere else.
event.past_the_point.wren.why: no longer opens like the reading-night line ('Don't mind me')

event.story_cat.intro.text: Don't move. A cat has chosen your boots. Years I've lived here, and it's never once chosen mine.
event.story_cat.intro.why: saves 'eight years' for the bag, where it lands

dlg.wren.birthday.r1.text: That was dreadful. Do it again, louder. The glasses are rattling in protest.
dlg.wren.birthday.r1.why: a drink image instead of yet another stool joke

event.wren_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.wren.glass}A toast, and a good one. I'll be telling it for years, longer each time.{else}{if choice:bday.wren.sing}Your song's the new house anthem. Nobody asked. It's permanent.{else}A hug. Of everything on the shelf tonight, that's the best gift.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_birthday.after.why: drops the fourth 'eight years' and the 'improvements' tic

dlg.wren.courtship.r2.text: Wait. Fair. I'm a bartender. Waiting is half the job, and I'm good at the other half.
dlg.wren.courtship.r2.why: stool was in three courtship lines; this one is hers alone

event.wren_courtship2.intro.text: Last time you said wait, so I waited. Patiently, which surprised everyone. I still like you. More, actually.
event.wren_courtship2.intro.why: no longer opens 'Sit.' like the first ask, and stops repeating 'good at waiting' from its own close

event.wren_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.wren.yes}Walks, then. And poems. You're stuck with me, and I'm stuck with the stool.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.wren.friends}The best of friends. It's on my chalkboard now, in capital letters.{else}Still waiting, then. I'll keep the question behind the bar, next to the bag.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_courtship2.after.why: second wait ends on a callback to the bag (heart 8 is required), not on a repeated joke

event.wren_partners.intro.text: Evening, love. I wrote you a song. It's terrible. It's mine. Sit and be sung at.
event.wren_partners.intro.why: 'pickle-eater' assumed the birthday scene, which is not certain; pickles were wallpaper

event.wren_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.wren.song}The song's finished now. Your name's in the bridge. That's why I sang it twice.{else}{if choice:courtship.wren.dance}We danced. Nobody looked. Everybody looked. I loved it.{else}The bag under my bar is empty. I unpacked it this morning. You were the reason, quietly.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_partners.after.why: pays off r0's bridge, and no longer clashes with heart 10's 'second verse has a map'

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l3.text: That's the best verse you've ever said out loud. Write it down, in pencil. Ink makes you shy.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l3.why: keeps Piper's 'Pencil it is'; cuts one of six 'improve' lines

event.overheard_wren_piper_4.l3.text: Do both. Cry first, song after. I'll sell handkerchiefs at the door.
event.overheard_wren_piper_4.l3.why: stool joke swapped for Wren's habit of selling to her own events

threads.wren_heart2: When will Wren be brave enough to cook real food? (Heart 6.)
threads.wren_heart5: What happens in the saloon at four o'clock, the quiet she has timed?
threads.wren_heart4: Does a second verse of the bath song exist, and is it really worse?
threads.wren_heart6: The dish goes on the chalkboard Friday under the player's name.
threads.wren_heart8: The bag is still packed; what will she do with the answer?
threads.wren_heart10: The song carried the bag choice; the sea or the stay is still ahead.
threads.wren_birthday: How long will the toast, song or hug story grow?
threads.story_cat: The cat now has a sixth name, or a winner, and the village will argue.
threads.wren_courtship: Walks and terrible poems, a friendship in chalk, or a question still waiting.
threads.wren_courtship2: The question waits behind the bar, next to the bag.
threads.wren_partners: The bag is unpacked, or the song is finished: Wren has chosen to stay.
threads.hall_dance: Someone still has to count the porch for Wren's story.

notes: overheard_tilda_wren_3: card already reads 'Come at seven' and hall_dance.9 already reads 'Six winters'; both brief items are done, nothing to change.

reading_night: Wren is placed in the scene even when her line's condition (met.wren && hearts:wren>=3) is false, so she stands there silent. Also Ione opens with 'Four chairs' but five people are present; Ione's close says 'every chair taken'. Ione or the Director should reconcile.
Variety: cut repeats of 'eight years' (now only bag.1, the shipped-tone source), 'stool' and 'improve' across scenes; 'Between us' stays in three lines (birthday.0, bram_1, hazel_3) as the signature.
wren_heart4 still diverges from the bible (own song instead of introducing Piper); left as Round 1 noted.
